description: Update the pipeline stage of one of your tracked applications (applied, interview, offer, or rejected/declined) using an application_id from list_applications. Moving an application to rejected marks it declined so it leaves active counts while remaining in your history, without blocking the company. Never withdraws an application at the employer.

stage.description: Target stage: applied (Sent), interview, offer, or rejected (Declined).

name: update_application_stage
title: Update application stage
